text: Hana - 22wks pregnant, all fine @ scan. bump finally showing. wants a girl but not telling anyone the name
Ivan broke wrist falling off ladder sat. cast for 6 wks. right hand so can't drive. offered lifts, he said maybe end of the month
dentist 9:40 thurs. then pick up dry cleaning + return parcel @ post office. sort car tax before end of month

Miriam's mum in hospital again - chest infection, 3rd time this yr. M exhausted, back & forth every eve after work, then up early for the kids. her brother Ignacio lives miles away, so it's all on her. she said she's fine but cried a bit on the phone. ring her sometime next week, don't just text. maybe offer to do school run thurs
Katarzyna + Hugo - baby boy!! born tues 3am, 3.4kg. called him Leon after K's grandad. both knackered but happy. send card + something small
Mabel's dog Biscuit had op on his leg, recovering ok. she's working from home rest of wk to keep an eye
Francesca - christening for the baby early March, St Anne's. we're invited. ask F what they'd want as a gift. she said silver stuff is a no
Hoang's dad diagnosed w/ diabetes type 2. Hoang trying to get him off the sugar, not going well lol. he's flying out to see him over the summer
Leon - kidney stones, in agony all wkend. hospital mon, sent home w/ painkillers. check in wed
gym membership renews 1st - cancel before. also new running shoes, old ones dead

Kiri expecting #2, due late April. Astrid (her eldest) apparently v excited to be big sister, already picking names, all of them Disney. morning sickness worse this time round, lost weight 1st trimester, now on tablets from GP. her partner Hoang doing nights so she's mostly solo w/ Astrid in the evenings. they're hoping to move somewhere bigger over the summer before baby comes
Hiroshi's knee surgery moved to the 14th. I'm driving him there that morning. need to text him the day before re: what time to collect
Connor - son has chickenpox, whole nursery has it. C off work all wk. poor guy sounded frazzled
Rafael + Beatriz - 1st scan next tues!! nervous bc of what happened last time. don't forget to message R afterwards

Pedro's grandma passed sun, 94. had been in a home for a couple of yrs w/ dementia, so not a shock but he's gutted. she basically raised him while his mum worked. funeral sometime next week, prob thurs, in Porto - he's flying out the day before. send flowers to his mum's. and text him the morning of, just so he knows I'm thinking of him
car MOT due early Nov. book garage. tyres prob need doing too
Aurelio - back op went well, home the next day. physio starting a week after. must pop round w/ food once he's settled
Asha said Blessing had the baby!! girl, Joy, born fri. Blessing + Chidi doing great. Asha organising a collection - chip in
Carmen - migraines constant since sept. GP referral to neuro, appt end of the month. she's fed up, nobody taking it seriously
Joy's little one, Hugo, starting nursery after Xmas. she's dreading it. also mentioned she's pregnant again - 10 wks, early days
Farid - wife Pooja due any day. he's on paternity from the day she goes in. said he'll msg the group when it happens
Jin twisted ankle @ 5 a side. swollen, x-ray tmrw to rule out fracture. ask how it went afterwards
Pooja's son Nikhil in hosp w/ appendicitis - op last night, fine now. home in a couple days. P barely slept. remind me to drop off dinner weds
renew passport!! expires Feb. photos from Boots first. then sort travel insurance sometime next week

Matilda - mum's had a fall @ home, broke her hip. lay there 2hrs before neighbour found her. surgery sat, prob a week in hosp. M staying with her the week after, then her brother Nikhil takes over. M v stressed, juggling work + her own kids, boss not v understanding. need to check in w/ her sun after the op. she likes those lavender bath things - maybe a little care pkg
Ignacio + wife - IVF round 2 starts early March. he's cautiously hopeful. don't bring it up unless he does
Bilal - the baby's christening.. actually aqiqah, not christening. sun 2nd, at the community hall. Bilal's mum cooking. take something for the baby

Andile's dad - stroke last wk. in ICU, stable now but can't move left side. doctors saying next few wks crucial. Andile flying to Durban fri, open return, work being decent about it. he's trying to hold it together for his mum. check in once he lands, and again a week after
Chidi said Blessing's struggling a bit since the birth - not sleeping, low. he's worried. I should message her, keep it light. she loves those almond croissants from the bakery
Hana's baby shower 15th - nappy cake? she said they've got loads of clothes already, wd love a sling
Ivan - cast off! wrist still stiff, physio twice a wk till end of month. back driving
Katarzyna - baby has jaundice, back in hosp for light therapy. 2 days prob. K holding up. text tmrw

weekend: hoover, clear out spare room, take old cot to tip. sat morning before the rain. then big shop - list on fridge. sun: batch cook for the week, finally fix the bathroom tap (washer?). if time, sort the photos for the album I keep saying I'll do. early night, back to the 6am alarm mon
Hugo - paternity leave ends mon, dreading going back. said baby's sleeping 3hr stretches now. small mercies
Miriam - mum discharged! home with carers 2x a day. M finally sleeping. had a proper laugh for once
Kiri - 20wk scan the 9th, finding out gender. ask her the next day!
Astrid broke her collarbone on the trampoline. Kiri says she's milking it, wants ice cream every day. cast/sling for 4 wks
Hoang's wife Hana pregnant!! due early June. Hoang already researching prams obsessively. congrats msg
Leon - 2nd stone. ugh. op to remove sometime next week. he's on a waiting list, might get a call any time. said he's fine but sounded flat

Connor's dad - prostate cancer, caught early thank god. starts radiotherapy end of month, 5 wks daily, mon-fri @ the Royal. C going w/ him first session, then his mum does the rest. dad apparently v matter of fact about it all, cracking jokes w/ the nurses. C less so - not sleeping, keeps googling. don't forget to ask C how the first one went, and offer to cover his shifts if he needs
pharmacy - repeat prescription. bank - pay in cheque from gran. post Mabel's birthday card by weds
Rafael - scan fine!! heartbeat strong. due 3rd week of May. they're telling family @ Beatriz's parents' sun
Pedro - funeral was lovely he said. family all came over from Lisbon. staying a week after with his mum. ring him when he's back
Aurelio's wife Matilda - said he's a terrible patient lol. won't rest. physio says 6 months min. he wants to go back to golf by summer
Beatriz craving pickles + ice cream, the cliché. hates the smell of coffee now. no more coffee dates for a bit
Carmen - neuro appt cancelled, rescheduled to early Dec. she's furious. maybe take her out for lunch sometime next week to distract her

Asha - knee replacement booked 18th @ the Nuffield. she's really nervous, first proper op, keeps reading horror stories online. her son Farid can't get time off till the weekend. offered to walk her dog Pepper the wk after + do a shop. text her good luck the night before. she said she'll need something to read - crime novels
Joy said Hugo's had an ear infection, 2nd this month. antibiotics. GP talking about grommets
Farid - baby boy, Rafael Jr, born early hours mon! 8lb 2oz. Pooja had a rough labour but both fine now. Farid on cloud nine. send congrats + get something for Rafael Jr
Jin - not broken, bad sprain. crutches 2 wks. annoyed bc misses the half marathon. ask him how physio goes
Pooja - Nikhil back at school, all good. P back at work mon. she wants to treat herself to a spa day over the summer
Matilda + Nikhil - their mum doing better, walking with frame. moving into Nikhil's spare room end of the month for a bit. M relieved
Ignacio - positive test!! v early, 5 wks. cautious. hasn't told work. pls don't say anything
call council re: bins. sort dad's birthday present early March - book? and buy new phone charger

Bilal - baby teething, nobody sleeping. tried everything, frozen flannels, gel, the amber necklace his aunt swears by. Bilal's mum staying a few wks to help out, which helps + also doesn't lol. his wife Carmen back at work end of the month so they're sorting nursery. B said he'd kill for a lie-in. he's into his coffee - nice beans wd go down well
Andile - back from SA. dad home, slow recovery, speech improving. Andile's sister Kiri staying w/ him. A says he's ok but went quiet. coffee sometime next week
Hiroshi - op done, knee brace for 6 wks. picked him up afterwards, groggy but fine. get him those mochi he likes for when he's bored
Mabel - preg!! 12wks, due mid-May. she + Ivan over the moon. she's been so sick, couldn't keep anything down for wks. anyway baby's fine on the scan

Katarzyna's sister Astrid (Asti) flying in from Kraków for the baby's christening, early Dec, prob 2nd sun. big Polish do afterwards at their place, K's mum cooking for 40. K asked me to be godparent!! honestly so touched. need to find out what that involves - do I have to say stuff in church? sort outfit sometime next week, and get a proper gift, engraved something
Francesca's dad - hip op. she's going up the day before, staying till he's home. her husband Hiroshi has kids. message her the morning of
